name: Quebec
title: Quebec Rebate Calculator 2026: LogisVert and Rénoclimat
h1: Quebec Rebate Calculator 2026: What You Could Get Back
desc: Free Quebec rebate calculator. Hydro-Québec LogisVert heat pump and thermal storage grants and the new Rénoclimat insulation, window and flood protection grants. Every number sourced.
intro: Answer a few questions and see which Quebec rebates fit your home, with a source for every number.
short: Hydro-Québec's LogisVert pays up to $6,700 for an eligible heat pump, $15,000 for an electric thermal storage system and $1,000 per kW for solar. Rénoclimat, changed on October 1, 2026, pays up to $7,000 for exterior walls, $2,000 for the roof and $300 per window for a house.
faq: How much is the Quebec heat pump grant?

Up to $6,700 from Hydro-Québec's LogisVert program for an ENERGY STAR heat pump on its eligible list. Combine at least two measures in one application for a 5% bonus. The application portal is in French only.
What changed in Rénoclimat on October 1, 2026?

A pre-work energy evaluation is no longer required but is recommended, an evaluation grant is offered, and a flood protection stream was added. A new portal was still being built when we read the page.
Does Rénoclimat pay for a heat pump?
Not on the pages we read. Heat pump money comes from LogisVert. Rénoclimat pays for insulation, windows, a backup power connection and a fixed battery.
Yes, with higher maximums: up to $5,000 for the roof, $11,000 for walls and $3,500 for foundations.
